📺 American Housewife (2016–2021)

American Housewife follows Katie Otto, a confident, outspoken, and unapologetically honest mother raising her three children alongside her supportive husband, Greg, in the wealthy town of Westport, Connecticut. Unlike the seemingly perfect families surrounding her, Katie refuses to conform to the community’s unrealistic expectations of beauty, parenting, and social status. Determined to keep her children grounded, she constantly battles the pressures of suburban life while navigating hilarious family conflicts and unexpected challenges. Her oldest daughter, Taylor, struggles with teenage responsibilities, her ambitious son Oliver dreams of becoming wealthy, and her youngest daughter, Anna-Kat, faces her own personal challenges. With the support of her closest friends, Katie finds humor in the everyday chaos of motherhood. Starring Katy Mixon and Diedrich Bader, the series delivers relatable comedy, heartwarming family moments, and meaningful lessons about self-confidence, acceptance, parenting, friendship, and embracing imperfections rather than trying to live up to everyone else’s expectations.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Family • Sitcom

⭐ IMDb: 7.4/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 22 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creator: Sarah Dunn

📺 Seasons: 5 • 103 Episodes

📍 Setting: Westport, Connecticut.

📺 Where to Watch: Hulu, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV (United States; availability may vary).
